word_order: SVO | Examples like “消防指挥系统的例行测试 引发 了一场电力故障” (主语—动词—宾语) show canonical SVO order in the sample.
register: written, formal informational text (news reports, encyclopedic/technical descriptions, web copy).
clause_boundary_signals: 是 (copula introducing a predicate noun phrase)
non_boundary_traps: 的 (attributive/nominalizer; inside NP, not a clause end)
数字/日期短语 (例如 “1759 年 9 月 24 日”)
括号、引号内的内容 (parentheticals/quotes are often embedded, not clause-final)
notes_for_prompt_writer: Treat verbs like 导致/引发/使得 and reporting verbs (报道、说道) as clause heads that usually require their following object/complement before finalizing a segment. Avoid splitting immediately after nominal modifiers marked by 的, and do not finalize on simple coordinators (和/与/及) or inside parentheticals/quoted descriptions. Wait for the end of a prepositional or temporal phrase starting with 在, a list introduced by 包括, or a comparative phrase 与...相比 before emitting a translation unit.
